Across languages, DharmaNexus aligns passages of the sutta with several Chinese texts, including the *Dīrghāgama* (長阿含經, T 1), *Saṃyuktāgama* (雜阿含經, T 99), and cosmological treatises such as the *Qishi jing* (起世經, T 24), *Qishi yinben jing* (起世因本經, T 25), and *Daloutan jing* (大樓炭經, T 23), in addition to Tibetan canonical texts such as the *Mahāvyutpatti* (D4346) and *Kuṇālāvadāna* (D4145) [DharmaNexus].
